MASTER COURT CALENDAR SET FOR JAN-11-2021 - MITCHELL WONG, ESQ. SPECIALLY APPEARING FOR PLAINTIFF IN PERSON. PHILIP GREEN, ESQ. APPEARING FOR DEFENDANT VIA COURTCALL. THE COURT SET AN ORDER TO SHOW CAUSE ISSUED TO ATTY. CHRIS MANDARICH (ATTORNEY OF RECORD FOR PLAINTIFF) FOR JAN-29-2021 IN DEPARTMENT 206 AT 9:30 AM TO SHOW CAUSE WHY SANCTIONS, IN THE AMOUNT OF $250.00, SHOULD NOT BE IMPOSED FOR FAILURE TO COMPLY WITH THE COURT'S ORDER PURSUANT TO THE NOTICE OF TIME AND PLACE OF TRIAL AND TRIAL ORDER. NOTICE SENT BY COURT. THE COURT GRANTED PLAINTIFF'S ORAL MOTION TO CONTINUE THE TRIAL DATE WITH A CONTINUANCE FEE OF $60 TO BE PAID VIA E-FILING AND INITIALLY SET THE NEW TRIAL DATE FOR 04/21/21. HOWEVER PLAINTIFF INQUIRED IF THE $250 SANCTIONS WOULD BE WAIVABLE IF THE CASE WERE TO BE DISMISSED. THE COURT RESPONDED BY CONTINUING THE TRIAL DATE TO JAN-20-2021 AT 9:30AM IN DEPT. 206 FOR PARTIES TO RETURN AND IF THE CASE IS RESOLVED, THEN THE COURT WILL VACATE THE OSC ON 01/29/21 AND FORGIVE THE $250 SANCTION. PARTIES MAY APPEAR VIA COURTCALL. PARTIES WAIVED NOTICE. JUDGE: SAMUEL K. FENG; MATTER NOT REPORTED (206/SKF)
